top_signals.title: Warlords of Greece: Warfare in Homer’s World
top_signals.summary:
The Iliad and Odyssey have shaped Western ideas of heroism for nearly three millennia. Yet despite centuries of debate over whether they reflect historical reality or poetic fantasy, the Homeric world remains an internally consistent universe worth studying on its own terms.
